title: Illustrative AI knowledge and retrieval
description: Illustrative knowledge pipeline from source lineage through ingestion, indexing, retrieval, generation and human review. It uses no proprietary data or live model, and does not claim verified answer quality.

metadata.evidence: Declared illustrative pipeline with inferred stages and proposed storage and feedback paths.
